entries.subject: DAMIT 1834: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1834, version 2017-06-19, pole (174°, 36°), period 16.7809 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 1833 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 125 ± 3 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model. DAMIT marks model 1834 as size-calibrated (D = 125 km, σ = 3 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 125 ± 3 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 47 light curves, 1 adaptive-optics image and 1 occultation (Table 3). Both pole solutions reproduce the adaptive-optics and occultation data; the paper says the second pole (this model) "might be preferred" but does not reject the first.
